about.description: RDW is a single-stock perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking Redwire Corp., margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 50× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
